profile.headline: Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure at Nuro

positions.title: Cloud Reliability Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Terraform · Kubernetes · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · argoCD · Helm Charts

positions.title: System and Application Administrator
positions.description:
- Utilize Ansible playbooks to simplify device enrollment and to deploy changes to Linux systems at mass
- Create and deploy Bash & Python scripts to deploy via MDM for system maintenance & automation
- Experienced with utilizing SSH keys in enterprise systems & software version control systems (GIT)
- Administer, and maintain all Atlassian applications (Jira/Confluence) and their database via (Google GCP, Terraform & Salt
- VMWare experience with vCenter, ESXi, vSphere Client & Horizon for VDI deployment
- Install, document, and troubleshoot complex networks and/or network components throughout the
enterprise including switch installation, bringing switch ports up for specific VLANs, port patching/disabling

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist (Intern)
positions.description: Providing Tier 2 and 3 support for facility computer system and applications troubleshooting. Consulting of internal customers by translating business requirements into technical solutions.

positions.title: Information Technology Student Assistant
positions.description:
A/V support for General purpose/ NG classrooms
Utilize ticketing systems for inventory and asset tracking management
Process documentation

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
IT Intern, reporting directly to Lead Systems Administrator.
Maintain and document network and system diagrams.
Administer the creation and deletion of user accounts among varying systems.
Prepare checklists and processes for LAN help desk.
Monitor procedures to safeguard systems for physical harm and viruses, unauthorized users and damage to data.

positions.title: Wedding and Banquet Expediter Manager
positions.locationName: 4601 Hill Top View Ln, San Jose, CA 95138
positions.description: Collaborating with waiters in providing food and beverage service to guests in a prompt and professional way. Assisting customers with questions or concerns in a polite and courteous professional manner, providing information regarding products and services. Monitoring and maintaining cleanliness, sanitation, and organization of assigned station and service areas.

positions.title: Intern Student
positions.description:
Hands on hardware and software training
Obtained CompTIA A+ and Apple Service Fundamentals Exam
